original_benchmark.notes: Epoch AI Chess Puzzles v2. Upstream runs a custom Inspect AI loop (qa_agent) whose only tool is submit_answer; no Harbor-compatible CLI agents are supported upstream.

harbor_adapter.notes: WIP: 100/100 CLI oracle on Harbor 0.27.0 with separate verification in local Docker on 2026-11-21; six original/CLI correct, wrong and missing-answer controls passed. Original-prompt qa_agent and matched local context-counting compatibility mode are implemented and tested with simulated responses. Ten puzzle IDs are predeclared for Haiku 5.5 parity. No completed model parity or registry publication.
